title: Billing Manual, Final Statement Chapter — Utility Pass-Through Service Final Read, Closing and Collections Referral
content:
This chapter governs the end of service on a Utility Pass-Through Service account: the final read, the final statement, closing, and referral of an unpaid final balance.

## Rule

1. When the lease ends — on the vacate date of a notice to vacate, the closing date of an in-place home sale, or the date possession returns after a termination — a final read is ordered for that date, and a withdrawn notice to vacate cancels it.
2. The final read is taken on the service end date and the final statement issued within the schedule's final-statement period in calendar days, with fixed charges prorated to the service end date and one administration fee.
3. The account closes when the final balance reaches zero, a credit balance being refunded.
4. An unpaid final balance is referred to collections only after the schedule's collections referral period has passed, counted from the final statement due date. The referral period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the due date, and the referral may be made no earlier than the day after the last day of the period. The due date is the one the final statement carries in the account ledger.
5. A final balance paid in full before referral closes the account instead.

## Account status through the end of service

| Event | Account status afterwards |
|---|---|
| Final read ordered for the date the lease ends | Final read pending, with that date as the service end date |
| Notice to vacate withdrawn | Active again, service end date cleared |
| Final read taken and final statement issued | Final billed |
| Final balance reaches zero (or paid in full before referral) | Closed |
| Final balance still unpaid after the referral period | Referred to collections |

## Referral timing worked on dates (hypothetical: final statement due 21 April, 60-day referral period)

Day 1 of the period is 22 April; 30 April is day 9, 31 May is day 40, and 20 June is day 60, the last day of the period.

| Date | May the unpaid final balance be referred? |
|---|---|
| 20 June (last day of the period) | No |
| 21 June (day after the last day) | Yes, from this day on |

If the former resident pays the final balance in full on 15 June, before referral, the account closes instead.

## Points of judgement

- **Which date does the final read take?** The date the lease ends — the vacate date, the sale closing date or the date possession returns, as the case may be.
- **Does the final statement carry the full month of fixed charges?** No; fixed charges are prorated to the service end date, and the statement carries one administration fee.
